name: MaxWin International Holdings Limited
summary: IAG Holdings Limited functions as an investment holding company, primarily focusing on the manufacturing and sale of injection-molded plastic components for single-use medical devices. The company also provides specialized tooling services, involving the fabrication of molds critical for the injection molding process. Its plastic products encompass both individual parts and assembled sub-components, designed for a variety of medical applications such as respiratory, dialysis, blood bag, drug delivery, and diagnostic equipment. Major clients include prominent multinational medical device corporations based in the United States, Europe, and Japan.
